we have presented a novel image-based approach for modeling building façades from street images, that we have demonstrated that the approach works for many façades from different cities and countries, and that it is robust to the presence of occlusion.

our approach can be summarized as: a) a semi-automatic approach to image-based façade modeling that relies on structure from-motion to recover camera positions; b) a top-down recursive subdivision followed by a bottom up merging of rectilinear patches; c) a depth optimized for each patch using the 3-D points cloud; and, d) an easy user feedback.
